newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak c.bank o/n repo average yield at 54.56 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak c.bank o/n repo average yield at 54.56 pct.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said on Wednesday the average yield at its overnight repo tender hit 54.56 percent, the same level as in the last o/n repo tender on Tuesday.
The NBS said in a statement it accepted 4.5 billion crowns of the 10.930 billion crowns bid in the tender
The minimum yield in the American style tender was 50.0 percent while the maximum yield was 75 percent.
The central bank has been deliberately keeping the local banking sector short of crown liquidity over the past two weeks in order to protect the currency against speculative pressure.
According to NBS figures, the banking sector lacked some 37.73 percent of required funds to meet minimum reserves requirements as of June 3.
